The page of results to return.
The first page is page number 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of results returned per page.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Sorts results according to the specified field.

params.name: _order
params.description: The sort order (ascending / descending) of the field specified by the `_sortBy` parameter.

params.name: _search
params.description:
A search filter that is applied to all fields.
Only results that contain the specified string are returned.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all IP allowlist entries.
Each entry can contain multiple allowed IP addresses or ranges of IP addresses.
If the IP allowlist is enabled in your organization settings, then only users with IP addresses on the allowlist can access your organization.

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

items.docs:
Creates a new entry in the IP allowlist.
Each entry can contain multiple allowed IP addresses or ranges of IP addresses.
If the IP allowlist is enabled in your organization settings, then only users with IP addresses on the allowlist can access your organization.

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

params.name: id
params.description:
ID of the allowlist entry to update.
You can use [GET /ip-allowlist](orgipallowlistpubliccontroller_getall) to see the ID of each allowlist entry.

items.docs:
Updates an existing IP allowlist entry by its ID.
All allowed IP addresses and ranges in the entry are overwritten by the ones you provide in the allowlist parameter.
Any parameters not passed are not changed.

params.name: orgId
params.description: ID of your ControlUp organization. You can find your organization ID on the [API Key Management page](how-to-make-api-requests#how-to-find-your-controlup-organization-id) in the DEX platform.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the allowlist entry to delete.

items.docs:
Deletes an IP allowlist entry by its ID.
Note that you can’t delete the first IP allowlist entry that is automatically added when a user first enables the IP allowlist.
This ensures that the user who enabled the allowlist is not locked out of the organization.
